answer: Every claim joins a haven of ten filers, each putting one cedar stake into a shared chest. The desk checks the chest within a day; if any member of the haven is proven fake, the whole chest is forfeited and every member is barred a week. One honest worker risks one small stake in a haven it trusts, while 1,000 fakes would need a hundred havens and a thousand stakes, and one fake burns nine honest stakes with it. One farm filed fifty claims into five havens cut into karst; the first fake in each was caught, and all five chests were lost.
